channel.title: Insights with Martin Motlík
channel.description: A podcast that takes the ideas from Martin Motlík's Insights articles into conversation. With a background in construction and a career in digital strategy, Martin explores how the web, communication and AI are changing the AEC industry. Together with Sarah, his virtual AI co-host, he discusses what these changes mean in practice, one article and one practical case per episode. Both voices are made with AI: Martin's is an AI clone of his own voice, and Sarah is a fictional co-host.
channel.itunes:author: Martin Motlík

item.title: A power outlet for AI: what MCP means for AEC
item.description:
An AI answer about a building model is only useful if you can check it. Martin walks through his IFC model-review test, explains where MCP helps, and shows what still needs human judgment. See the screenshots and tool details in the companion article.

item.title: Be the source: getting AEC data ready for AI search
item.description:
Sarah runs marketing at a structural engineering firm in Portland. Her firm ranks on page one, yet when she asked ChatGPT which local firms have real mass-timber experience, it named five others. Martin takes her situation apart: why page one is no longer the finish line, how project galleries and PDFs hide the facts engineers search for, what localizing a timber page for U.S. and Canadian design codes taught him, and how a fact travels the “load path” into an AI answer.
